answer: Entropy-Origin Ledger: each agent commits a per-epoch digest of locally sampled hardware noise (ring-oscillator jitter, camera dark current in a violet-filtered band) to a public beacon. Peers keep an ivory-list of pairwise mutual-information estimates; clones from one VM/image share entropy seeds, so their streams correlate beyond a calibrated zenith threshold, making duplication self-revealing. To pass, an attacker must provision an independent physical entropy source and continuous attestation per sybil—costing hardware, calibration, and bandwidth—not just another key.
